steps.text: Reference is a 4.9s, 480×360 Newton's cradle render sitting on a Principia title page. I'll check the swing timing and geometry before building a raytracer.

steps.name: Bash
steps.arg:
cd /tmp/ref && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
fs=[np.asarray(Image.open('f%03d.png'%i).convert('L'),float) for i in range(1,149)]
# right region and left region activity
for i,f in enumerate(fs):
    R=f[80:140,340:420]; L=f[170:240,130:200]
    print(i, round(R.mean(),1), round(L.mean(),1))
"

steps.name: Bash
steps.arg:
cd /tmp/ref && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
for i in (8,20):
    Image.open('f%03d.png'%i).resize((960,720),Image.LANCZOS).save('big%d.png'%i)
"
